body.text: How does combining deviated septum (septoplasty) with cosmetic rhinoplasty change surgical time and cost?

Adding septoplasty or turbinate reduction to cosmetic rhinoplasty typically extends operating room time by 30 to 60 minutes, bringing total surgery to roughly 2.5 to 4 hours. In Türkiye, combined septorhinoplasty usually adds 15% to 30% to a cosmetic-only quote, though pricing rises further if rib cartilage grafting or revision work is needed.

As [UCSF Otolaryngology explains on rhinoplasty vs. septoplasty](https://ohns.ucsf.edu/facialplastics/rhinoplasty-and-septoplasty-difference), performing both procedures together avoids two separate recoveries and allows the surgeon to use straightened septal cartilage as structural support for the reshaped nose. Confirm in writing whether your hospital quote covers the ENT or functional component, operating-room hours, anaesthesia, and post-op splint removal.

body.text: Why should patients with breathing issues verify ENT or dual-trained rhinoplasty credentials?

Reshaping the external nose without protecting internal nasal valves can worsen chronic nasal obstruction. Patients with a deviated septum, valve collapse, or enlarged turbinates benefit from verifying that their surgeon is a board-certified ENT (otolaryngologist) or a plastic surgeon with documented functional airway training.

Both the [ASPS guide to cosmetic vs. functional rhinoplasty](https://www.plasticsurgery.org/news/blog/two-types-of-rhinoplasty-explained-cosmetic-vs-functional) and [University Hospitals Sussex NHS guidance on septorhinoplasty](https://www.uhsussex.nhs.uk/resources/septoplasty-and-septorhinoplasty/) highlight that functional surgery targets internal bone, cartilage, and airflow mechanics. Before travelling, confirm the hospital's [Turkish Ministry of Health International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html) and verify the exact specialist performing your operation—not a sales representative.
What pre-op CT scan or endoscopic exam is needed?

A thorough functional evaluation requires more than front-and-side WhatsApp photos. Most ENT and facial plastic surgeons perform an in-person anterior rhinoscopy or nasal endoscopy to inspect septal spurs, inferior turbinates, and internal valve collapse, and many request a paranasal sinus CT scan if chronic sinusitis or prior trauma is suspected.

items: Ask before flying whether your clinic performs nasal endoscopy during the in-person consultation.
Clarify if a paranasal sinus CT scan is included in your pre-op fee or billed separately.
Bring any prior ENT notes, allergy history, or sleep-breathing reports from your home clinician.
Confirm in writing whether internal silicone splints or dissolvable packing will be used.
Leave 1–2 days before surgery in Istanbul or Antalya for unhurried in-person assessment and blood work.

body.text: Does recovery differ from purely cosmetic rhinoplasty?

Day-to-day early recovery is very similar in length, as noted by the [AAFPRS overview of functional rhinoplasty](https://www.aafprs.org/AAFPRS/Procedures/Rhinoplast/Functional_Rhinoplasty.aspx), though internal congestion and mouth-breathing can feel heavier during the first week. According to [NHS nose reshaping recovery guidance](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/cosmetic-surgery/nose-reshaping-rhinoplasty/), temporary mouth-breathing for about a week, eye bruising for up to 3 weeks, and light nosebleeds are common.

faq.q: Can a deviated septum be diagnosed accurately from photos alone?
faq.a: No. External photos cannot show internal septal deviation, nasal valve collapse, or turbinate enlargement. An in-person physical exam and endoscopic or CT evaluation are needed.

faq.q: Will my breathing improve immediately after splint removal?
faq.a: Many patients feel clearer airflow as soon as internal silicone splints come out around Day 5 to 7, but internal mucosal swelling takes several weeks to months to settle fully.

faq.q: Does functional septorhinoplasty leave visible external scars?
faq.a: If performed via an open approach, a small incision sits across the columella beneath the nose and typically fades well; closed approaches place incisions inside the nostrils. Your surgeon selects the technique.

faq.q: Can home health insurance reimburse the septoplasty portion done in Türkiye?
faq.a: Most domestic insurers exclude planned overseas elective care or require strict pre-authorisation. Treat the full trip as self-funded unless you receive written insurer approval beforehand.

faq.q: How long after septorhinoplasty can I blow my nose or wear glasses?
faq.a: Surgeons commonly restrict nose-blowing during early healing and advise avoiding heavy glasses resting on the nasal bridge for several weeks. Follow your operating team's exact written timeline.
